newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan exchange plans grain futures index in Oct 97.
newsitem.headline: Japan exchange plans grain futures index in Oct 97.

text.p: Kansai Agricultural Commodities Exchange in Osaka said on Friday it plans to launch a yen-based international grain futures index in October 1997.

The index will include contracts for corn, wheat, soybeans and other commodities listed on U.S., Canadian and Japanese commodity exchanges, converting prices into yen where necessary. The index's base value will be calculated from average prices for 1993.
The exchange will ask a private research institute, SRIC Corp, to study the listing of contracts, and is expected to apply to the Trade Ministry around next March for permission to go ahead.
"The new grain futures index is expected to provide a risk hedging opportunity for trade houses and makers," an exchange official said.
